function.name: inspect_state
function.description: Inspect the current mapped molecular state and enumerate legal electron sources and sinks.

function.name: import_fragment
function.description: Import one mapped fragment that is absent from the product but required by the next inverse transition.

fragment_smiles.description: Atom-mapped fragment SMILES with unique positive map numbers.

function.name: apply_electron_move
function.description: Apply one explicit two-electron source-to-sink move to the current state.

function.name: apply_coupled_electron_moves
function.description: Apply a non-empty list of coupled two-electron moves atomically as one elementary event.

function.name: finish_trace
function.description: Compile the committed environment-owned trace, execute it, and derive the only admissible precursor endpoint.

function.name: abstain
function.description: Terminate the episode without an unsupported precursor when available evidence is insufficient.

MECH_PROOF v1
TARGET_SMILES "[NH+:1]([C:2](=[O:3])[O:17][CH3:5])([CH2:14][CH2:13][CH2:12][CH2:11][CH3:4])[CH2:15][c:18]1[cH:10][cH:8][cH:7][cH:9][n:16]1"
ROOT s0
PRECURSOR_STATE s2
EDGE s0 s1
  IMPORT "[Cl-:6]"
  BOND 2 3 -1
  BOND 2 6 +1
  LP 3 +2
  LP 6 -2
  CHARGE 3 0 -1
  CHARGE 6 -1 0
EDGE s1 s2
  BOND 1 2 -1
  BOND 2 3 +1
  LP 1 +2
  LP 3 -2
  CHARGE 1 1 0
  CHARGE 3 -1 0
</proof>
